nodes.name: Campaign webhook
nodes.notes: REQUIRED: select Header Auth credential: name x-campaign-webhook-secret, value equal to app N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Missing credentials must fail closed.

nodes.name: Groq response
nodes.notes: REQUIRED: select a separate Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <Groq API key>. The openai/ model prefix is a model identifier, not an OpenAI API credential. Never reuse the webhook or callback credential.

nodes.name: Callback result
nodes.notes: REQUIRED: separate Header Auth credential: x-campaign-callback-secret = app N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET. Set n8n CAMPAIGN_CALLBACK_URL to the exact app callback URL (Compose sets this). Request URLs must match this local destination. Success and failure envelopes are delivered; HTTP errors stop the execution after three tries. No durable delivery guarantee; inspect failed executions/logs. Missing credentials must fail closed.
